lines: Koi jaane na, kyun mujh se sharmaaye
couplets.en: Who knows why those eyes turn shy before me?

lines: Kaise mujhe tadpaaye
couplets.en: How they leave me longing.

lines: Pyar bhare do sharmeele nain
couplets.en: Two shy eyes full of love.

lines: Jin se mila mere dil ko chain
couplets.en: In them my heart found rest.

lines: Dil ye kahe, geet main tere gaaoon
couplets.en: My heart would have me sing of you.

lines: Tu hi sune aur main gaata jaaoon
couplets.en: Let me sing on with only you to hear.

lines: Tu jo rahe saath mere, duniya ko thukraaoon, tera dil behlaaoon
couplets.en: If you stay beside me, I would turn away from the world to ease your heart.

lines: Pyar bhare do sharmeele nain
couplets.en: Two shy eyes full of love.

lines: Roop tera kaliyon ko sharmaaye
couplets.en: Even flower buds blush at your beauty.

lines: Kaise koi apne dil ko bachaaye
couplets.en: How could anyone keep their heart safe?

lines: Paas hai tu phir bhi jaloon, kaun tujhe samjhaaye, saawan beeta jaaye
couplets.en: You are near and still I burn, and who will tell you as the rains slip by?

lines: Pyar bhare do sharmeele nain
couplets.en: Two shy eyes full of love.

lines: Dar hai mujhe, tujh se bichhar na jaaoon
couplets.en: I fear we may be parted.

lines: Kho ke tujhe, milne ki raah na paaoon
couplets.en: If I lose you, I may never find my way back.

lines: Main aansoo ban jaaoon
couplets.en: I might dissolve into tears.
